visual.issue: The start-up steps dead-end for anyone who buys before 2027, which is the launch window the listing targets ('start this week'). Start here step 4, listing 'How to start' step 3 and photo 4 step 3 all say 'Tap Year, then today's date. Fill Today's top 3', and Restart says 'Tap the month tab, then today's date'. But the Year page and the JAN to DEC tabs cover 2027 only. Nov and Dec 2026 have no day pages and no Today's top 3. On head-start pages no tab is active, and NOV or DEC jumps to 2027.
visual.where: start, restart, year, hs11 rail; listing.description 'How to start'; photo-04-ph4_apps.jpg

visual.issue: The guide pages look half-empty. Each Start here and Restart card holds 2 or 3 lines at the top and is about 70% blank. On Setup check the three buttons are oversized, and the 'Nothing happened?' box is about 65% blank. The same empty pages appear in photos 3, 4 and 7.
visual.where: start, restart, linktest; photo-03, photo-04, photo-07

visual.issue: Photo 5 ('Any day in two taps') shows four small, static thumbnails with no arrows or callouts, so the tabs, Home, back trail and day arrows it promises can't be seen at listing size. Its alt text describes arrows and circled tabs that are not in the image.

Setup check says 'Use the Home tab at the top to come back', but Home opens Contents, not Setup check. None of the three target pages links back, so the test-and-return loop takes an extra tap each time.

Week 1 shows Mon to Thu Dec 28 to 31 greyed at 40% opacity (about 2:1 contrast), although the head start ends Dec 27 and these boxes are the only place to plan those four days. Week 1 has no back arrow to the last head-start week, and that week's 'Continue' goes to the January month page, not to Week 1.
The first head-start week starts Mon Oct 26 2026. A buyer on Oct 21 to 25 has no page for 'this week', despite the 'Start this week, not January' headline.

Weeks that span two months disagree. Aug 31's crumb says 'August / Week 36', but Week 36's own crumb says 'September', and Aug 30 to 31 sit after the September month and habit pages. The same happens with Mar 29 to 31 after April, and with May 1 to 2 against 'April / Week 18'. Swiping day by day from Aug 29 passes 3 September pages before Aug 30.
The day page draws seven bordered boxes (Energy and Basics are separate), while photo 2 and the listing say 'six boxes'. The Energy box is about 60% empty under the 1 to 5 circles.
The Energy map key (Lots of energy, Steady, Low, Running on empty, Rest day) does not map to the day page's Energy 1 to 5 scale, and the column under the key is about 65% empty.
Year page rows don't line up across months in the same band. February and June rows are spaced wider than January and May, so dates sit at different heights.

Contents has an empty 12th card slot and about 300px of blank space between the month buttons and 'How the links work'. Labels repeat: the 'NOTES / Notes' card, and the 'SETUP CHECK' kicker over the 'Setup check' title.

Photo 1 has a stray coral bar cut off at the top-right edge of the image. The rear tablet (Jan 11 day page) has no caption, and 'Linked from the year to the hour' overclaims, since time blocks are not linked and links stop at the day.
Photo 2 is labelled 'Day page, real size', but the page fills about 57% of the frame width and the bottom fifth of the image is empty.

Photos 3 and 6 to 9 leave large empty bands above the tablets and across the bottom 20 to 33%. In photo 7 the three pages are too small to read. Photo 4's alt text says the Start here page is 'faded' and that it lists tablets, but neither is true.
